summary: Iteration 3 (SQLite local storage + duration presets + offline Tor GeoIP) fully verified. All 12 backend pytest cases pass (100%) in ~92s serial run. Frontend loads with all 22 required data-testids (17 legacy + 5 new duration-preset-*). UI: clicking short disables the Watch (custom) input with grey styling; clicking custom re-enables it. Live Job panel streamed 'watch=90–180s (random per video)' hint on medium-preset submission. Offline Tor GeoIP resolved country as 'Italy' (readable, not 'Unknown').
passed: GET /api/ → storage=sqlite, rotation_interval=3, duration_presets={short:[30,60], medium:[90,180], long:[240,420], xlong:[460,800]}
GET /api/tor/status → offline geo returns readable country name (Italy, not Unknown)
POST /api/jobs duration_preset=medium + http → [i] Job started log contains 'watch=90–180s' and [play] log line reports 'for Ns' with 90<=N<=180
POST /api/jobs duration_preset=short + views=1 + http → completes in ~30-60s, [play] line shows 'for Ns' with 30<=N<=60, >=5 log rows persisted, SSE replays historical events
POST /api/jobs duration_preset=custom, watch_seconds=5, views=2, http → completes fast, every [play] line shows exactly 'for 5s'
Frontend loads, hero rendered, top-strip shows exit IP + country (Italy) — offline geo working
Click duration-preset-short: watch-seconds-input becomes disabled=true and short button gets emerald selected style; grey border applied (border-zinc-900 text-zinc-600) confirming non-editable state
Click duration-preset-custom: watch-seconds-input becomes disabled=false, custom button gains emerald selected style
Submit medium preset + browser-mode-http job: LiveJobPanel streams SSE and displays '[i] Job started. total_videos=1, rotate_every=3, engine=http, watch=90–180s (random per video)' immediately

minor.issue: Same as prior iteration — malformed IDs may return 500 instead of 404. Not tested this run (unchanged code path); flagged for completeness.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~510 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. run_job() (~110 lines) and the CC_TO_NAME map (~25 lines) are good extraction candidates.

asyncio.create_task(db.insert(...)) inside Broadcaster.publish() still has no error handling — SQLite is far more reliable than Supabase so risk is lower, but on disk-full or WAL corruption logs would be silently dropped. Consider await instead of fire-and-forget since SQLite writes are fast.

local_storage.SQLiteStore opens+closes a new aiosqlite connection per operation (insert/update/select). Under bursty log traffic (~1 event / few ms during a rotation) this is measurable overhead. A single long-lived connection guarded by the existing self._lock would be more efficient.

tor_ip_geo relies on the container's tor process having exposed GeoIP data (typical). Missing tor GeoIP dbs would silently return 'Unknown' — consider logging a warning once at startup so debug is easier.
run_job() computes 'next_rot' but LiveJobPanel recomputes client-side — leaves the same divergence risk noted in iteration 2.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 jobs during backend tests (medium/1 view/http, short/1 view/http, custom/2 views/http) + 1 job during frontend test (medium/1 view/http). All inserted into local SQLite; log rows persisted in yt_job_logs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini forces -n 2 loadscope. Because Tor rotation is global process state, run backend tests with `-n 0` (serial) — full run ~92s and passes 12/12. Frontend automation must use wait_for_load_state('domcontentloaded') NOT 'networkidle' because the SSE EventSource keeps the network permanently busy — networkidle will time out. The medium+http job used in FE verification completes in ~90-180s but the [i] Job started log with the range hint appears within 1-3s so no need to wait for completion.
rca of the issue: N/A — no unresolved bugs. All 12 backend tests and all frontend interactions pass on first attempt after tests were rewritten from the old Supabase schema.
